items.title: Joel Dorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: I depend on Gene a lot.

ctx.x: Yeah, so technology means nothing to me. And I read these reviews and somebody will say it was a brilliant stereo mix or it was the worst stereo mix, I depend on Gene a lot. But I always say like about people that say to me like Gene Paul — I always say the same thing, he gets the sound that I would ask for if I knew what to ask for.
That’s a good one. What do your kids think of what you’ve done?
